Villain checks. Hero bets $350. Villain calls.

This is one of the best possible flops to continue on. Hero's range is uncapped. He has K-K+ and A-K in his range. Most Villains will 5-bet all-in with those combos. Very few Villains will call with offsuit K-x combos.
So Hero is usually up against about nine K-x combos: K¥-Q¥, K#-Q&, Ke-Q¢, K¥-J¥, K&e-Je&, Ko-JO, KY-10¥, K&-10& and Ke-10¢.
Compare that to about 30 combos of Q-Q - 8-8 and a bunch of worthless Broadway hands. Hero must continue to apply pressure.

There are two betting patterns that can be used when the stack-topot ratio is 2.5-to-1. In cash games, usually c-bet about 65% of the pot and shove favorable turn cards. In tournaments, usually c-bet 30%, turn bet 40% and shove the river. Fold equity is the most important factor in cash games. Stack utility is the most important factor in tournaments.
